changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cmr_strategy_version ADD COLUMN threshold DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.60 COMMENT '相似度阈值 0.30-0.99' AFTER top_k;

changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cmr_evaluation ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', biz_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'EVL 编号', query VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL COMMENT '评测 query（同一 query 只留一条）', base_search_id BIGINT COMMENT '基准检索历史 id', base_task_no VARCHAR(32) COMMENT '基准任务号', base_time DATETIME COMMENT '基准时间', base_n INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '基准结果数', base_down INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '基准踩数', create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', UNIQUE KEY uk_biz_no (biz_no), UNIQUE KEY uk_query (query(255)) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 效果评测';
